messages.text:
A few things broke in the game, and I'd like them all fixed:

1. The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0.
2. I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore.
3. I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate.
4. The game started beeping when I find a pair.

Keep the rest working, and please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed the four regressions:

- Best scores now keep the lower move count, and an unearned best displays `none` ([storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:61), [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30)).
- Arrow keys move focus within the board, respecting edges and modifiers ([use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:27), [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx:42)).
- Reduced motion disables card transitions and the win pulse ([card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:49), [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:38)).
- Removed synthesized match and win audio ([use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:78)).

Type check, all 138 unit tests, the fresh build, and all 75 browser journeys passed on the project’s named runtime. The edited files pass Prettier; the repository-wide format check still flags unchanged files outside this work.
